# Switch in the bootstrap look

Its parts, props and data attributes: [Switch](https://menhir-ui.com/docs/components/switch.md).

## SwitchExample.tsx

```tsx
import { Switch } from "menhir/switch";

import styles from "./switch.module.css";

export default function SwitchExample() {
  return (
    <label class={styles.field}>
      <Switch.Root name="wifi" defaultChecked class={styles.track}>
        <Switch.Thumb class={styles.thumb} />
      </Switch.Root>
      Wi-Fi
    </label>
  );
}
```

## switch.module.css

```css
/* Bootstrap's .form-switch: a track two ems wide with a round thumb, sized
   by the label's text. Bootstrap draws the thumb as a background image; here
   it is the Thumb, in the same colours. */
.field {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5em;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.track {
  --inner: calc(1em - 2 * var(--bs-border-width));
  display: inline-flex;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  align-items: center;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  width: 2em;
  height: 1em;
  padding: 0 calc(var(--inner) * 0.125);
  border: var(--bs-border-width) solid var(--bs-border-color);
  border-radius: 2em;
  background-color: var(--bs-body-bg);
  font: inherit;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition:
    background-color 0.15s ease-in-out,
    border-color 0.15s ease-in-out,
    box-shadow 0.15s ease-in-out;
}

.track[data-checked] {
  border-color: var(--bs-primary);
  background-color: var(--bs-primary);
}

.track:focus-visible {
  border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bs-white) 50%, var(--bs-primary));
  outline: 0;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 var(--bs-focus-ring-width) var(--bs-focus-ring-color);
}

.track[data-disabled] {
  opacity: 0.5;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.thumb {
  display: block;
  width: calc(var(--inner) * 0.75);
  height: calc(var(--inner) * 0.75);
  border-radius: 50%;
  background-color: color-mix(
    in srgb,
    var(--bs-emphasis-color) 25%,
    transparent
  );
  transition: translate 0.15s ease-in-out;
}

.thumb[data-checked] {
  background-color: var(--bs-white);
  translate: 1em;
}

.track:focus-visible .thumb[data-unchecked] {
  background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bs-white) 50%, var(--bs-primary));
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .track,
  .thumb {
    transition: none;
  }
}
```
